job.name: ig2_cover
job.person_note: The presenter must be exactly the man from the second attached photo.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER built EXACTLY in the light editorial design system from the FIRST attached board: warm off-white #F5F3EE background, black #111111 condensed bold headlines, vivid red #FF3B30 highlight box, thin red line chart. The presenter is the man in the grey shirt over a black T-shirt from the SECOND attached photo (same face, hair, clothes) — photorealistic, the same person. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text: big title in two lines «ВЫ ЗАБУДЕТЕ» / «ЭТО ВИДЕО» (the second line white on a red box). No other words, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no handles. High contrast, readable at small size in the profile grid.
job.style_qa: обложка в стиле приложенного светлого борда, ведущий из приложенного фото узнаваем и не искажён, надпись «ВЫ ЗАБУДЕТЕ ЭТО ВИДЕО» без ошибок, другого текста нет
job.meaning: обложка 9:16 Reels «Вы забудете это видео» (кривая забывания)
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The presenter waist-up in the lower two thirds, centred, looking at the viewer with a slightly intriguing expression. Behind him a thin red falling curve (forgetting curve) sweeps across the background, without axis labels. The title sits in the upper third, centred, inside the central 4:5 safe area so it is not cropped in the profile grid.
